externalDocs.description: The SuperOffice DevNet Community has more documentation, examples, and discussion forums.

SOPassword.description:
SuperOffice username:password are passed in Base64-encoded. 

You can also pass inn an unencoded ticket 7T:abc== with the HTTP Authenticate header.

SuperId.description:
SuperOffice SuperId OAuth implicit flow. 
You need to issue a request to the SuperId authorization URL
    https://online.superoffice.com/login/common/oauth/authorize?response_type=token
      &client_id=670734e0-4c5a-11e3-be9e-a171392e81db
      &redirect_uri=https://example.com/spa/

passing in the application id and redirect URL.

SuperId will log the user in, and redirect to the requested redirect URL with a #payload
containing the access token and claims. (The redirect URL must be registered with SuperId in advance)

   https://example.com/spa#access_token=8A%3aCust12227.AXRrCITpPBvQX3UbIohb
      &token_type=bearer
      &state=
      &expires_in=3600
      &ctx=Cust12227
      &netserver_url=https%3a%2f%2fsod.superoffice.com%2fCust12227%2fRemote%2fServices82%2f

You can take the #access_token value and pass it as the Authenticate HTTP header as a BEARER token.

SuperOffice.WebApi.v1.Carriers.CustomObj.description: GetCustomFieldDefinitions: Returns all custom field definitions of a table, in rank order.

SuperOffice.CRM.Services.FieldInfoBase.description:
Abstract basic information about database fields. May be custom or user-defined fields. The information can be used to build a user interface.
<para />
Carrier object for FieldInfoBase.
Services for the FieldInfoBase Carrier is available from the <see cref="T:SuperOffice.CRM.Services.IUserDefinedFieldInfoAgent">UserDefinedFieldInfo Agent</see>.

FieldType.description: What sort of data does this field contain. 1 = int, 2 = short text, ...

DisplayName.description: Label for field. May be multi-lang string encoded.

Description.description: Optional tooltip text for this field

ShortLabel.description: Short name to be used in Archive headings and on page 1. If blank, the fieldLabel will be used everywhere.

HideField.description: Hide the field from the UI. Only allow API access.

IsIndexed.description: Is this field indexed? 0 if no, index no. if yes

IsMandatory.description: 0 = no, 1 = yes (field must be filled out)

IsExternal.description: Should this field be shown to external users via customer center?

IsDisplayField.description: Flag indicating that this field is chosen as DisplayField for a table it belongs

Rank.description: Tab order, ranking within the custom fields.

TemplateVariableName.description: Template variable name: 'cs01', 'cl02' etc. Null for extra fields.

IsDefaultListColumn.description: Custom-object fields only: true if the field is one of the default columns where rows of the custom object are listed (archive default columns, previews, bulk update); users can still add or remove columns. Mirrors the ViewInList extra-field flag. Not used on standard tables or user-defined fields.

ApplyDefaultValue.description: Extra fields only: true if new rows get DefaultValue; false leaves the field empty even when DefaultValue is set (0 and false are real defaults). Ignored for relation, Link and Attachment fields. Mirrors the UseDefault extra-field flag. Not used on user-defined fields.

IsFreetextSource.description: Custom-object fields only: true if the field's values are freetext-indexed, so rows can be found by text in this field; it also makes relation pickers on this custom object search as you type. The display field is always indexed, whether or not this is set. Mirrors the ViewInSearch extra-field flag. Not used on standard tables or user-defined fields.

ShowInSideCard.description: Request (ticket) extra fields only: true if the field is shown in the Request side card, next to the built-in properties, instead of the details area. Ignored for other tables. Mirrors the ShowWithProperties extra-field flag. Not used on user-defined fields.

SuperOffice.WebApi.v1.Carriers.CustomObj.description: GetCustomFieldDefinition: Returns one custom field definition by table and field name.

CreateCustomFieldDefinitions: Adds custom fields to a table. The body is an array of field definitions: one column is added per element, all or nothing. Fails if any FieldName already exists. Not implemented yet.

SaveCustomFieldDefinitions: Creates or updates custom fields on a table in one call: each element is added when its FieldName is new and updated when it exists, all or nothing. Fields of the table that are not in the body are left alone. Not implemented yet.
UpdateCustomFieldDefinition: Updates one existing custom field. FieldName and FieldType cannot change. Not implemented yet.
DeleteCustomFieldDefinition: Deletes a custom field: drops the column with its data and index. Not implemented yet.
CreateDefaultCustomObject: Returns a new Custom Object row pre-populated with the default values declared by the Custom Object Definition. The row is not yet persisted.

SuperOffice.CRM.Services.CustomObject.description:
A single row in a Custom Object table.
<para />
Carrier object for CustomObject.
Services for the CustomObject Carrier is available from the <see cref="T:SuperOffice.CRM.Services.ICustomObjectAgent">CustomObject Agent</see>.

ObjectName.description: Database table name of the Custom Object this row belongs to, e.g. 'y_equipment'.

Values.description: Column values for this row. Keys are database column names; values are formatted with CultureDataFormatter (e.g. '[I:42]' for integers).

FieldProperties.description: Field property dictionary mapping field names to field access rights.

SuperOffice.CRM.Security.TableRight.description:
Wraps a table right together with an explanatory reason.
Code can indicate why access is restricted.

SuperOffice.CRM.Security.FieldProperty.description: Class holding properties like field length, field type about a field in the carrier.

SuperOffice.CRM.Security.FieldRight.description:
Wraps the field right together with an explanatory reason.
Also adds logical operators to the field rights so that they can be easily combined.

SuperOffice.WebApi.v1.Carriers.CustomObj.description: GetCustomObject: Returns a single Custom Object row by definition name and primary key.
CreateCustomObject: Inserts a new Custom Object row. Id in the row is ignored. Not implemented yet.
UpdateCustomObject: Updates an existing Custom Object row by primary key. Not implemented yet.
DeleteCustomObject: Deletes a single Custom Object row by primary key.

SuperOffice.CRM.Services.CustomObjectDef.description:
Schema definition for a Custom Object: the underlying table and its fields.
<para />
Carrier object for CustomObjectDefinition.
Services for the CustomObjectDefinition Carrier is available from the <see cref="T:SuperOffice.CRM.Services.ICustomObjectAgent">CustomObject Agent</see>.

Id.description: Primary key in the extra-tables table.

ObjectName.description: Database table name of the Custom Object, e.g. 'y_equipment'.

Title.description: User-visible title of the Custom Object.

DisplayField.description: Name of the field used to represent a row in lists and previews.

IconId.description: Icon binary-object id used in the UI.

IconHint.description: Resolved icon hint for the UI: 'ph-<name>' for a Phosphor icon, the table name for an uploaded SVG icon, or 'CustomObject' for the default icon.

Fields.description: Field definitions for this Custom Object, in rank order. Each element is a FieldInfo* type selected by FieldType.

IconName.description: Name of a Phosphor icon, e.g. 'truck'. Takes priority over IconId; IconHint shows the resolved result.

IsHidden.description: True if the Custom Object is left out of every list that offers custom objects (navigator, menu, Find, webhook events, lists). Its data is kept. Mirrors the Hidden extra-table flag.

HideIdField.description: True if archives hide the id field (column and criterion), as long as another visible field exists. Mirrors the HideId extra-table flag.

ShowInFind.description: True if the Custom Object is offered in Find. Ignored when IsHidden is set. Mirrors the ShowInFind extra-table flag.

ShowInNavigator.description: True if the Custom Object gets a navigator button and main-menu entry. Ignored when IsHidden is set. Mirrors the ShowInNavigator extra-table flag.

ParentField.description: Name of the field that points to the parent row, which makes the Custom Object a tree in relation lists. Empty: flat list.

FullNameField.description: Name of the field holding each row's full path in the tree, e.g. 'Support/Hardware/Keyboards'; shown in relation lists and archives. Requires ParentField.

SortField.description: Name of the field that orders rows in relation lists (dropdowns and pickers) before a search term is typed. Default 'id'. Archives sort independently.

SortDescending.description: True to sort relation lists by SortField in descending order.

HierarchyId.description: Folder (HierarchyEntity in the ExtraTables domain) the Custom Object is listed under in admin lists. 0: top level.

FieldProperties.description: Field property dictionary mapping field names to field access rights.

SuperOffice.WebApi.v1.Carriers.CustomObj.description: GetCustomObjectDefinition: Returns the schema (table + field definitions) for a Custom Object by its database table name.
CreateCustomObjectDefinition: Creates a Custom Object: the table together with the fields in Fields, all or nothing. Fails if a Custom Object with that ObjectName already exists. Not implemented yet.

UpdateCustomObjectDefinition: Updates the table properties of an existing Custom Object. Fields is ignored; use CreateCustomFieldDefinitions, UpdateCustomFieldDefinition and DeleteCustomFieldDefinition to change fields. Not implemented yet.
DeleteCustomObjectDefinition: Deletes a Custom Object: drops the table with all its fields and rows. Not implemented yet.
HasScreenChooser: Returns true if a screen chooser is configured for the given Custom Object and mode.

SuperOffice.CRM.Services.CustomObjectMet.description:
Bootstrap metadata for a Custom Object table.
<para />
Carrier object for CustomObjectMetadata.
Services for the CustomObjectMetadata Carrier is available from the <see cref="T:SuperOffice.CRM.Services.ICustomObjectAgent">CustomObject Agent</see>.

Name.description: User-visible name of the Custom Object.

IconHint.description: Icon hint string for the UI.

FlagHideId.description: True if the primary key field should be hidden in the UI.

FlagHidden.description: True if the Custom Object is hidden from the navigator.

FlagShowInFind.description: True if the Custom Object should appear in the Find dialog.

FlagShowInNavigator.description: True if the Custom Object should appear in the navigator.

HasWebPanels.description: True if the Custom Object has web panel archives configured.

SuperOffice.CRM.Services.CustomObjectRel.description:
Describes a relation from a Custom Object to another entity.
<para />
Carrier object for CustomObjectRelation.
Services for the CustomObjectRelation Carrier is available from the <see cref="T:SuperOffice.CRM.Services.ICustomObjectAgent">CustomObject Agent</see>.

EntityName.description: Database table name of the related entity.

EntityType.description: Type of the related entity, e.g. 'contact', 'CustomObject'.

EntityTitle.description: User-visible title of the related entity.

ProviderName.description: Archive provider name for listing related rows.

RelationField.description: Database column name of the foreign key field.

DisplayField.description: Database column name of the display field for the related entity.

HideFunctions.description: True if the functions (add/edit/delete) should be hidden for this relation.
